articles.abstract_en: National and local governments have implemented a large number of policies in response to the Covid-19 pandemic. Evaluating the effects of these policies, both on the number of Covid-19 cases as well as on other economic outcomes is a key ingredient for policymakers to be able to determine which policies are most effective as well as the relative costs and benefits of particular policies. In this paper, we consider the relative merits of common identification strategies that exploit variation in the timing of policies across different locations by checking whether the identification strategies are compatible with leading epidemic models in the epidemiology literature. We argue that unconfoundedness type approaches, that condition on the pre-treatment “state” of the pandemic, are likely to be more useful for evaluating policies than difference-in-differences type approaches due to the highly nonlinear spread of cases during a pandemic. For difference-in-differences, we further show that a version of this problem continues to exist even when one is interested in understanding the effect of a policy on other economic outcomes when those outcomes also depend on the number of Covid-19 cases. We propose alternative approaches that are able to circumvent these issues. We apply our proposed approach to study the effect of state level shelter-in-place orders early in the pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 国家和地方政府为应对Covid-19疫情实施了大量政策。评估这些政策对Covid-19病例数量以及其他经济结果的影响，是政策制定者确定哪些政策最有效以及特定政策的相对成本和收益的关键要素。在本文中，我们通过检查识别策略是否与流行病学文献中的主要流行病模型兼容，来考虑利用不同地点政策实施时间差异的常见识别策略的相对优点。我们认为，由于疫情期间病例传播的高度非线性，以疫情前处理“状态”为条件的无混杂性方法可能比双重差分法更有助于评估政策。对于双重差分法，我们进一步表明，即使当人们感兴趣的是政策对其他经济结果的影响，而这些结果也依赖于Covid-19病例数量时，这个问题的一个版本仍然存在。我们提出了能够规避这些问题的替代方法。我们将我们提出的方法应用于研究疫情早期州级居家令的效果。

articles.title_en: Identification of auction models using order statistics
articles.title_cn: 利用次序统计量识别拍卖模型
articles.abstract_en: Auction data often contain information on only the most competitive bids as opposed to all bids. The usual measurement error approaches to unobserved heterogeneity are inapplicable due to dependence among order statistics. We bridge this gap by providing a set of positive identification results. First, we show that symmetric auctions with discrete unobserved heterogeneity are identifiable using two consecutive order statistics and an instrument. Second, we extend the results to ascending auctions with unknown competition and unobserved heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_cn: 拍卖数据通常仅包含最具竞争力的出价信息，而非所有出价。由于次序统计量之间的依赖性，通常用于未观测异质性的测量误差方法并不适用。我们通过提供一组正向识别结果来弥合这一差距。首先，我们证明具有离散未观测异质性的对称拍卖可以利用两个连续的次序统计量和一个工具变量进行识别。其次，我们将结果扩展到竞争未知且存在未观测异质性的升价拍卖。

articles.title_en: Dynamic discrete choice models with incomplete data: Sharp identification
articles.title_cn: 数据不完整的动态离散选择模型：锐化识别
articles.abstract_en: In many empirical studies, those states that are relevant for forward-looking economic agents to make decisions may not be included in the data to which researchers have access. This problem often arises in the context of declining/booming industries. In this paper, we develop the sharp identified sets of structural parameters and counterfactuals for dynamic discrete choice models when empirical data do not cover realizations of relevant future states. Applying the proposed method to the annual Toyo Keizai database, we study the behaviors of Japanese firms on foreign direct investments in China without observing the future states after Chinese economy slows down.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多实证研究中，那些对前瞻性经济主体做出决策至关重要的状态可能并未包含在研究人员可获得的数据中。这一问题在衰退/繁荣行业中经常出现。在本文中，我们开发了当经验数据未涵盖相关未来状态的实现时，动态离散选择模型的结构参数和反事实的锐化识别集。将所提出的方法应用于年度东洋经济数据库，我们研究了日本企业在中国经济放缓后未观察未来状态的情况下对中国直接投资的决策行为。

articles.title_en: Identification-robust beta pricing, spanning, mimicking portfolios, and the benchmark neutrality of catastrophe bonds
articles.title_cn: 识别稳健的贝塔定价、跨越、模拟投资组合以及巨灾债券的基准中性
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes inference strategies for conditional and unconditional asset pricing models, which cover beta pricing, the zero-beta rate, risk prices, Jensen’s alphas, mean–variance spanning and intersection. We derive analytical conditions that link the identification of the zero-beta rate to spanning. Following finite-sample statistical considerations, the proposed procedures correct for measurement error with mimicking portfolios, and are invariant to fund repacking as well as and robust to: (i) missing factors, (ii) identification of risk price, and (iii) the quality of conditioning information. Empirically, we study benchmark neutrality of Catastrophe bond mutual funds. Results show that potential for diversification is significant before the 2008 financial crisis, yet lack support thereafter.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了条件和无条件资产定价模型的推断策略，涵盖贝塔定价、零贝塔利率、风险价格、詹森阿尔法、均值-方差跨越和交集。我们推导了将零贝塔利率的识别与跨越联系起来分析条件。遵循有限样本统计考虑，所提出的程序通过模拟投资组合纠正测量误差，并且对基金重新打包具有不变性，同时对以下方面具有稳健性：（i）缺失因子，（ii）风险价格的识别，以及（iii）条件信息的质量。实证上，我们研究了巨灾债券共同基金的基准中性。结果表明，在2008年金融危机之前，分散化的潜力显著，但此后缺乏支持。

articles.title_en: Semiparametric estimation of latent variable asset pricing models
articles.title_cn: 潜变量资产定价模型的半参数估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies semiparametric identification and estimation of consumption-based asset pricing models with latent state variables. First, we measure how consumption, dividends, and prices depend on Markovian state variables describing aggregate output growth. Subsequently, we identify state-dependent components in the stochastic discount factor using the Euler equation. We develop tractable algorithms for filtering, smoothing, and sieve maximum likelihood estimation, and establish its consistency. Empirically, we find sizable nonlinearities in the impact of expected growth and volatility on the price–dividend ratio and discount factor.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有潜在状态变量的消费型资产定价模型的半参数识别与估计。首先，我们衡量消费、股息和价格如何依赖于描述总产出增长的马尔可夫状态变量。随后，我们利用欧拉方程识别随机贴现因子中的状态依赖成分。我们开发了用于滤波、平滑和筛极大似然估计的易处理算法，并建立了其一致性。实证上，我们发现预期增长和波动率对价格-股息比率和贴现因子的影响存在显著的非线性。

articles.title_en: Structural VAR models in the Frequency Domain
articles.title_cn: 频域中的结构向量自回归模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a joint methodology for the identification and inference of structural vector autoregressive models in the frequency domain. We show that identifying restrictions can be written naturally as an asymptotic least squares problem (Gouriéroux et al., 1985) in which there is a continuum of nonlinear estimating equations. Following Carrasco and Florens (2000), we then propose a continuum asymptotic least squares estimator (C-ALS) that efficiently exploits the continuum of estimating equations, thereby allowing to obtain optimal consistent estimates of impulse responses and reliable confidence intervals. Moreover, the identifying restrictions can be formally tested using an appropriate J-stat, and the frequency band can be selected using a data-driven procedure. Finally, we provide some Monte Carlo simulations and an application regarding the hours–productivity debate.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种在频域中识别和推断结构向量自回归模型的联合方法。我们表明，识别限制可以自然地写成渐近最小二乘问题（Gouriéroux等，1985），其中存在连续统的非线性估计方程。遵循Carrasco和Florens（2000）的方法，我们随后提出了一种连续统渐近最小二乘估计量（C-ALS），该估计量有效利用连续统的估计方程，从而能够获得脉冲响应的最优一致估计和可靠的置信区间。此外，识别限制可以使用适当的J统计量进行正式检验，频率带可以通过数据驱动程序选择。最后，我们提供了一些蒙特卡洛模拟和关于工时-生产率争论的应用。

articles.title_en: We modeled long memory with just one lag!
articles.title_cn: 我们用一阶滞后建模了长记忆！
articles.abstract_en: Two recent contributions have found conditions for large dimensional networks or systems to generate long memory in their individual components. We build on these and provide a multivariate methodology for modeling and forecasting series displaying long range dependence. We model long memory properties within a vector autoregressive system of order 1 and consider Bayesian estimation or ridge regression. For these, we derive a theory-driven parametric setting that informs a prior distribution or a shrinkage target. Our proposal significantly outperforms univariate time series long-memory models when forecasting a daily volatility measure for 250 U.S. company stocks over twelve years. This provides an empirical validation of the theoretical results showing long memory can be sourced to marginalization within a large dimensional system.
articles.abstract_cn: 最近的两项贡献发现了大规模网络或系统在其各个组成部分中产生长记忆的条件。我们在此基础上，提供了一种用于建模和预测具有长程依赖性的序列的多元方法论。我们在一个阶数为1的向量自回归系统内建模长记忆特性，并考虑贝叶斯估计或岭回归。对于这些，我们推导出一个理论驱动的参数设置，为先验分布或收缩目标提供信息。我们的提议在预测250家美国公司股票的日波动率指标超过十二年的情况下，显著优于单变量时间序列长记忆模型。这为理论结果提供了实证验证，表明长记忆可以源于大规模系统中的边缘化。

articles.title_en: High-dimensional conditionally Gaussian state space models with missing data
articles.title_cn: 高维条件高斯状态空间模型中的缺失数据处理
articles.abstract_en: We develop an efficient sampling approach for handling complex missing data patterns and a large number of missing observations in conditionally Gaussian state space models. Two important examples are dynamic factor models with unbalanced datasets and large Bayesian VARs with variables in multiple frequencies. A key observation underlying the proposed approach is that the joint distribution of the missing data conditional on the observed data is Gaussian. Furthermore, the inverse covariance or precision matrix of this conditional distribution is sparse, and this special structure can be exploited to substantially speed up computations. We illustrate the methodology using two empirical applications. The first application combines quarterly, monthly and weekly data using a large Bayesian VAR to produce weekly GDP estimates. In the second application, we extract latent factors from unbalanced datasets involving over a hundred monthly variables via a dynamic factor model with stochastic volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种高效的采样方法，用于处理条件高斯状态空间模型中复杂的缺失数据模式及大量缺失观测。两个重要例子是数据集不平衡的动态因子模型和包含多频率变量的大型贝叶斯VAR。所提出方法的一个关键观察是，给定观测数据时缺失数据的联合分布是高斯分布。此外，该条件分布的逆协方差或精度矩阵是稀疏的，这种特殊结构可以被利用来大幅加速计算。我们通过两个实证应用来说明该方法。第一个应用使用大型贝叶斯VAR结合季度、月度和周度数据来生成周度GDP估计。在第二个应用中，我们通过具有随机波动率的动态因子模型从不平衡数据集中提取潜在因子，该数据集包含超过一百个月度变量。

articles.title_en: Maximum likelihood estimation for α-stable double autoregressive models
articles.title_cn: α-稳定双自回归模型的最大似然估计
articles.abstract_en: The paper investigates the maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) for a first-order double autoregressive model with standardized non-Gaussian symmetric α-stable innovation (sDAR) within a unified framework of stationary and explosive cases. It is shown that the MLE of all parameters, including the stable exponent in the innovation, are strongly consistent and asymptotically normal (with the exception of the intercept for the explosive case). Particularly, the MLE of the parameter in the conditional location is always asymptotically normal, regardless of the stationary or explosive case. This point totally differs from that for linear α-stable AR models in Andrews et al. (2009). Furthermore, it is the first time to provide exact values of the quantities related to the innovation in the asymptotic covariance matrices when the true innovation is the standard Cauchy distribution. Additionally, a modified Kolmogorov-type test statistic is proposed for model diagnostic checking in the stationary case. Monte Carlo simulation studies are conducted to confirm our theoretical findings and assess the finite-sample performance of the MLE and the modified Kolmogorov-type test. An empirical example is analyzed to illustrate the usefulness of sDAR models.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在平稳和爆炸情形的统一框架下，具有标准化非高斯对称α-稳定新息的一阶双自回归模型（sDAR）的最大似然估计（MLE）。结果表明，所有参数（包括新息中的稳定指数）的MLE都是强相合且渐近正态的（爆炸情形下的截距项除外）。特别地，条件位置参数的MLE在平稳或爆炸情形下总是渐近正态的。这一点与Andrews等人（2009）的线性α-稳定AR模型完全不同。此外，当真实新息为标准柯西分布时，本文首次提供了渐近协方差矩阵中与新息相关的量的精确值。另外，本文提出了一种修正的Kolmogorov型检验统计量，用于平稳情形下的模型诊断检验。进行了蒙特卡洛模拟研究以证实我们的理论发现并评估MLE和修正的Kolmogorov型检验的有限样本性能。通过一个实证例子分析了sDAR模型的有用性。

articles.title_cn: 异方差下多重约束的检验
articles.abstract_en: We propose a hypothesis test that allows for many tested restrictions in a heteroskedastic linear regression model. The test compares the conventional F statistic to a critical value that corrects for many restrictions and conditional heteroskedasticity. This correction uses leave-one-out estimation to correctly center the critical value and leave-three-out estimation to appropriately scale it. The large sample properties of the test are established in an asymptotic framework where the number of tested restrictions may be fixed or may grow with the sample size, and can even be proportional to the number of observations. We show that the test is asymptotically valid and has non-trivial asymptotic power against the same local alternatives as the exact F test when the latter is valid. Simulations corroborate these theoretical findings and suggest excellent size control in moderately small samples, even under strong heteroskedasticity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种假设检验方法，允许在异方差线性回归模型中对许多被检验的约束进行检验。该检验将传统的F统计量与一个针对多重约束和条件异方差进行修正的临界值进行比较。这种修正使用留一法估计来正确居中临界值，并使用留三法估计来适当缩放临界值。该检验的大样本性质在一个渐近框架中建立，其中被检验的约束数量可以是固定的，也可以随样本量增长，甚至可以与观测数量成比例。我们证明该检验是渐近有效的，并且在精确F检验有效时，对相同的局部备择假设具有非平凡的渐近功效。模拟结果证实了这些理论发现，并表明在中等偏小的样本中，即使在强异方差下，也能很好地控制检验水平。

articles.title_cn: 稀疏协方差的后处理后验
articles.abstract_en: We consider Bayesian inference of sparse covariance matrices and propose a post-processed posterior. This method consists of two steps. In the first step, posterior samples are obtained from the conjugate inverse-Wishart posterior without considering the sparse structural assumption. The posterior samples are transformed in the second step to satisfy the sparse structural assumption through a generalized thresholding function. This non-traditional Bayesian procedure is justified by showing that the post-processed posterior attains the optimal minimax rates under the spectral norm loss in high-dimensional settings. We also propose the post-processed posterior for contaminated data and apply it to the estimation of the sparse idiosyncratic covariance of the approximate factor model. The advantages of our method are demonstrated via a simulation study and a real data analysis with S&P 500 data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑稀疏协方差矩阵的贝叶斯推断，并提出一种后处理的后验。该方法包括两个步骤。第一步，在不考虑稀疏结构假设的情况下，从共轭逆威沙特后验中获得后验样本。第二步，通过广义阈值函数对后验样本进行变换，以满足稀疏结构假设。这种非传统的贝叶斯程序通过证明后处理的后验在高维设置下在谱范数损失下达到最优极小极大速率而得到合理性证明。我们还提出了针对污染数据的后处理的后验，并将其应用于近似因子模型的稀疏特质协方差的估计。通过模拟研究和S&P 500数据的实际数据分析，展示了我们方法的优势。

articles.title_en: Large stochastic volatility in mean VARs
articles.title_cn: 均值向量自回归中的大随机波动性
articles.abstract_en: Bayesian vector autoregressions with stochastic volatility in both the conditional mean and variance (SVMVARs) are widely used for studying the macroeconomic effects of uncertainty. Despite their popularity, intensive computational demands when estimating such models has constrained researchers to specifying a small number of latent volatilities, and made out-of-sample forecasting exercises impractical. In this paper, we propose an efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm that facilitates timely posterior and predictive inference with large SVMVARs. In a simulation exercise, we show that the new algorithm is significantly faster than the state-of-the-art particle Gibbs with ancestor sampling algorithm, and exhibits superior mixing properties. In two applications, we show that large SVMVARs are generally useful for structural analysis and out-of-sample forecasting, and are especially useful in periods of high uncertainty such as the Great Recession and the COVID-19 pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 在条件均值和方差中均包含随机波动性的贝叶斯向量自回归（SVMVARs）被广泛用于研究不确定性对宏观经济的影响。尽管这些模型很受欢迎，但估计此类模型时密集的计算需求限制了研究者只能指定少量潜在波动性，并使样本外预测练习变得不切实际。在本文中，我们提出了一种高效的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）算法，该算法有助于对大型SVMVARs进行及时的后验和预测推断。在模拟练习中，我们表明新算法显著快于最先进的粒子吉布斯与祖先采样算法，并表现出更优的混合性能。在两个应用中，我们表明大型SVMVARs通常对结构分析和样本外预测有用，并且在高不确定性时期（如大衰退和COVID-19大流行）尤其有用。
